intro: The fifty-third screen read 126 pictures, the set's 21 and 105 probes, with sixteen readers and five scorers: 1,292 of 1,320 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. **63 of the 64 templates pass the legibility gate**, as in v0.55 and v0.54, and it is another one that fails. **`square_wheel`, under the gate in three of the last four screens, reads 1.00 in ten pictures**, five bicycles held by their owner and five wheelbarrows, the tier-4 playground's bicycle among them; `bird_steals` and `blocked_hose`, which v0.55 had at the gate's edge, read 1.00. **The one that fails is `play_catch`, 0.833 in three pictures, a drawing this release did not change:** in two gardens the ball stands at the fence's top above the catcher's hands, and each reader's catch has a half mark. Three more are under 1.00: `pan_watering` at 0.900, where the new shallow pan is a watering can first to two readers of five; `seesaw_heavy` at 0.933, where two readers give no weight as why the child is stuck; and `sitting_on_air` at 0.958. Of the 28 items under full marks, twenty are the clouds or a tree that a reader left out and eight are those four templates'. Nothing was mended, swapped or read again after the screen, so the count is the first and only one. The set's score is 0.975, for 0.972. On the strict count 55 of the 64 templates pass, for v0.55's 52. Every picture is new, so nothing here is a second reading of a picture, and the comparison with v0.55 is by template. The grown figures are called by a young name first in 6 of their 108 pictures, for 3 of 81.
design:
## Design tests

Placement revision 50 was read in whole pictures built for it (`vision/design_tests_v056.md`): nineteen new pictures with forced sets, two fresh readers each, dealt among the readings of the drawings' bench, and three more in its second round.
- **Read as intended, with no doubt:** the ladder against open sky (2 readings of 2, no support offered), the picnic's sitter on the larger blanket (4 of 4), figures at the pond (6 of 6, nobody in the water), the lost balloon above the railing (2 of 2), the dropped ice cream in front (4 of 4), the pram on the path (2 of 2) and the storm pointer with the bird table out of its line (2 of 2).
- **Failed, and mended:** the photographer. With a subject near and alone on its side all four readers still asked what the camera was aimed at. The figure was turned to the side, and in the three pictures of the second round all six readers named the subject first, each with something else offered beside it.
- **Found, and ruled out:** beside a hat the wind took, a child jumping for joy was "leaping to catch the hat", and under a floating box had thrown it. A jumper is no longer planned into a picture with either.
- **Left:** a duck by the angler's float and a walker behind fed birds, one reader of two each.

No picture of the set or the probes was built again after a reading.
redrawn: `square_wheel` reads 1.00 in ten pictures, for 0.938 in eight with a misread. `bird_steals`, `blocked_hose` and `ice_cream_drop` read 1.00, for 0.967, 0.975 and 0.982. Two drawings that the benches took are marked down by the screen: `seesaw_heavy` reads 0.933 for 1.00, and `pan_watering` 0.900 for 1.00. `play_catch`, which was not drawn again, reads 0.833 for 1.00 and is under the gate, and `sitting_on_air` 0.958 for 1.00. Every other template of the table reads 1.00, as it did. It is one screen, of 5 to 30 items a template in this table, and a half mark moves a mean by 0.02 to 0.10.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (15 in three, 12 in four, 26 in five, 4 in six, 2 in seven, and one each in eight, nine, ten, sixteen and twenty-two). 63 of 64 pass, as in v0.55 and v0.54; 64 did in v0.53. The count is the first and only one, with no fix and no re-read behind it. Four templates are under 1.00: `play_catch` (0.833 on six items in three pictures), which fails, `pan_watering` (0.900 on fifteen items in five pictures), `seesaw_heavy` (0.933 on fifteen items in five pictures) and `sitting_on_air` (0.958 on twelve items in four pictures); the other 60 read 1.00. Per angle (`vision/v056/gate_yaw.json`), all 19 (template, angle) pairs pass. The pass count rests on the scorers' rule as they applied it: with the 33 full marks that stand beside another reading halved, 55 of the 64 pass. The game of catch fails on two half marks in three pictures; in five pictures, as v0.55 screened it, the same two would leave it at 0.90. It was screened in three because nothing of it had changed, and the pictures round it had. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: Every cell of the set was built under revision 50 with the new cast, and none is v0.55's picture. Eleven of the twelve cells of tiers 1 to 3 placed on their showcase seeds and the tier-3 garden on a search past its own. The tier-4 park came from the free search on its fifth base and the tier-4 playground on a second range of seeds. The tier-4 garden is v0.46's set forced on v0.46's seed, as in v0.53 to v0.55, after fourteen bases failed. The tier-4 street is a forced set as well, after 46 bases failed: v0.55's street set with the dog that reads a newspaper in place of the man who sits on nothing, since the bicycle's owner is a ninth figure where the street had room for eight (`tools/cycle/forced_cell.py`). Four isomorphs of tiers 2 and 3 and one of tier 4 were found, the last after more than a hundred tries. The probe pass built 65 and left fourteen templates short; 27 small forced groups filled them, the pass stratified by angle added eight, and five more were forced for the square wheel's two carriers (`tools/cycle/extra_probes.py`): 105 probes, 53 gardens, 33 parks, 16 playgrounds and 3 streets. The twenty-five templates whose drawing or placing changed were each screened in five pictures or more. **I looked at all 126 pictures on contact sheets before any reader had them, found nothing to mend, and built none again after that look.** All 126 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 380 of 380. Its soft palette warning is raised by 322 records, for 313 of 355 in v0.55, with the median share of a figure's pixels on a palette colour as it was, 0.88. The target was not loosened.
calib: 85 of the calibration's 252 numbers moved by 0.002 or more, where six had in v0.55: the cast and the rules move every figure. The largest moves are on templates whose drawing changed: `bird_steals`'s inference (its salience from -1.76 to -1.13), `ladder_nothing`'s contradiction (from -0.44 to -0.08), `kite_in_tree`'s inference (from -0.54 to -0.73) and `square_wheel`'s contradiction (from 0.04 to -0.03). **Every prior was taken from it**, the three that v0.55 had left at v0.54's among them (`seesaw_heavy` is now -0.64, `sitting_on_air` 0.11 and `about_to_trip` 0.15): the set is new, so there were no plans to keep. Every record's predicted difficulty is computed from the new calibration, and every cell is in its band by it. The calibration was measured once, with the cast as it is released (`tools/cycle/calib_cmp.py`).
